||VM|| Technical Issues

FIXED.~Lexi


Hey all,

As you probably noticed, the server has been temporarily suspended. This is due to a serious exploit that had been discovered. The logs will be checked, and several permabans will be made; we thank those who informed us.

To other admins:

Contact either Chaz or KiZai before opening the server, as in its current state nobody should be on it. We have passworded the server as it was all we could think of doing, and we may have to roll back the database.

Stick with us guys, we will be back on our feet soon. Please don't ask exactly when it will be back up; in short: we don't know. When it is ready.

-KiZai
